photos.note: Useful for the straight-sided 0, curved 9, rounded 8 and the small top projection on J.
Useful for the sweeping 6/9, the changing slope of 7, and the rounded-rectangular bowl of P.
Later-period cross-check: the curved 7 and diagonal sweep of 9 remain visible. J and 1 need their own details.

vendors.name: Driver Gothic
vendors.note: Published default specimen, with its displayed alternate row. The 6 and 9 have upright, hooked constructions unlike the photographed B.C. sweeps. The default 1 has a foot, and the 7 is more diagonal/straight. No licensed font was installed or bundled.

vendors.name: License Plate — Dave Hansen
vendors.note: Published specimen, not a substituted system font. A useful condensed plate style, but its 6/9, narrower overall construction, S and J details do not reproduce the photographed B.C. alphabet. No font file was installed or bundled.
